about.title: Laguna Hills Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Laguna Hills residents rely on countless everyday products, from household appliances purchased near Moulton Parkway to tools and vehicles used along I-5 and Alicia Parkway. When a product fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can be serious and unexpected. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a claim under strict liability, which means the focus is on whether the product itself was defective rather than proving the maker acted carelessly. That distinction can matter a great deal for someone recovering from an injury in Laguna Hills who simply wants clear answers. We're here to help you understand your rights and options under California product liability rules. If a defective product has affected your life, keeping the item and any packaging can help preserve important evidence while you explore your options with our team.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, an injured person generally doesn't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent, only that the defect existed and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable under California product liability law, which may broaden who we can pursue on your behalf.

items.title: Evidence Preservation Matters Early On
items.desc: Keeping the defective product itself, along with packaging or instructions, can be important to a claim, and our team can advise you on how to protect that evidence.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability approach generally focuses on whether the product itself had a defect that caused your injury, rather than requiring proof of negligence. Our team can walk you through how this applies to your specific situation.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me in Laguna Hills?
items.answer: Try to preserve it exactly as it was at the time of the incident, including any packaging, manuals, or receipts if you have them. This can be valuable evidence, especially since Laguna Hills sees regular traffic and product-related incidents along corridors like Alicia Parkway and Paseo De Valencia. Our team can advise on safe storage and next steps.

items.answer: No. We offer a free case review and typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery.
